verdict.rationale: Docs claim integration with GitHub, GitLab, Slack, and Linear, and mention 'always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers' plus collaborating in Slack and reviewing PRs in GitHub, implying agent tasks can be triggered from these platforms. However, there's no detailed documentation or hands-on evidence showing the actual mechanics (e.g., commenting on a GitHub issue or Slack message to spawn an agent) or independent confirmation this works reliably. Missing for 10: concrete setup docs/screenshots for triggering agents from each named platform, independent/hands-on verification of the trigger flow, and confirmation for Linear specifically beyond a name-drop.
